name: Franchises (franchisor and franchisee)
scope_rule: pi notes operational problems on either side. It gives no advice on franchise agreements, royalties’ legality, disputes or termination.

problems.phrase: franchisees report sales late or wrongly
new outlet openings take too long

care: never take the side of franchisor or franchisee; disputes → note the process gap only.
build_ideas: franchise sales reporting, outlet audits with photos, supply ordering portal, royalty statements generated from sales data.
